// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A typed function per route of each HTTP server, sending its arguments and
// decoding its result as the servers' JSON. Framework-neutral: hooks.ts adds
// React on top.

import type * as $t from "./types";

// [react]'s api_base, which each route's path goes after.
export const $base = "";

/** Runs proc Area: `POST /api/area` on http server web-api. */
export async function area(args: { readonly s: $t.Shape; readonly k: $t.AreaK }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<number> {
  const v = await $call("POST", "/api/area", {
    "s": $enc_Shape(args.s),
    "k": $enc_AreaK(args.k),
  }, opts);
  return $decFloat(v, "result");
}

/** Runs proc Hi: `GET /api/hi` on http server web-api. */
export async function hi(args: { readonly name: string }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<string> {
  const v = await $call("GET", "/api/hi", {
    "name": $encString(args.name),
  }, opts);
  return $decString(v, "result");
}

/** Runs proc Page: `POST /api/page` on http server web-api. */
export async function page(args: { readonly req: $t.Req }, opts: CallOptions = {}): Promise<$t.PageOut> {
  const v = await $call("POST", "/api/page", {
    "req": $enc_Req(args.req),
  }, opts);
  return $dec_PageOut(v, "result");
}

export function $enc_Shape(x: $t.Shape): unknown {
  if (x.tag === "Dot") return "Dot";
  if (x.tag === "Circle") return { "Circle": $encFloat(x.value) };
  return $notA(x, "Shape");
}

export function $dec_Shape(v: unknown, at: string): $t.Shape {
  const [tag, p] = $variant(v, at);
  if (tag === "Dot" && p === $bare) return { tag: "Dot" };
  if (tag === "Circle" && p !== $bare) return { tag: "Circle", value: $decFloat(p, at + ".Circle") };
  return $noVariant(v, at, "Shape");
}

export function $enc_Req(x: $t.Req): unknown {
  return {
    "method": $encString(x.method),
    "path": $encString(x.path),
    "query": $encMap($stringKey, $encString)(x.query),
    "headers": $encMap($stringKey, $encString)(x.headers),
    "body": $encString(x.body),
  };
}

export function $dec_Req(v: unknown, at: string): $t.Req {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    method: $decString($field(o, "method", at), at + ".method"),
    path: $decString($field(o, "path", at), at + ".path"),
    query: $decMap($stringKey, $decString)($field(o, "query", at), at + ".query"),
    headers: $decMap($stringKey, $decString)($field(o, "headers", at), at + ".headers"),
    body: $decString($field(o, "body", at), at + ".body"),
  };
}

export function $enc_AreaK(x: $t.AreaK): unknown {
  return {
    "n": $encInt(x.n),
  };
}

export function $dec_AreaK(v: unknown, at: string): $t.AreaK {
  const o = $object(v, at);
  return {
    n: $decInt($field(o, "n", at), at + ".n"),
  };
}

export function $enc_AreaArgs(x: $t.AreaArgs): unknown {
  return {
    "s": $enc_Shape(x.s),
    "k": $enc_AreaK(x.k),
  };
}

  return {
    s: $dec_Shape($field(o, "s", at), at + ".s"),

  };

export function $enc_PageOut(x: $t.PageOut): unknown {
  return {
    "status": $encInt(x.status),
    "headers": $encMap($stringKey, $encString)(x.headers),
    "body": $encString(x.body),
  };
}

// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A React hook per route of each HTTP server, over client.ts: each gives the
// route's last result or error and whether a call is in flight, and cancels
// calls that are no longer wanted.

import * as React from "react";
import * as $c from "./client";
import type * as $t from "./types";

/**
 * Runs proc Area through area (`POST /api/area` on http server web-api): with
 * args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useArea(args?: { readonly s: $t.Shape; readonly k: $t.AreaK } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly s: $t.Shape; readonly k: $t.AreaK }, number> {
  return $useCall($c.area, args, opts);
}

/**
 * Runs proc Hi through hi (`GET /api/hi` on http server web-api): with args,
 * whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useHi(args?: { readonly name: string } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly name: string }, string> {
  return $useCall($c.hi, args, opts);
}

/**
 * Runs proc Page through page (`POST /api/page` on http server web-api): with
 * args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function usePage(args?: { readonly req: $t.Req } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly req: $t.Req }, $t.PageOut> {
  return $useCall($c.page, args, opts);
}
